title: Choose the visual world: CvAIEx homepage
question: The roll assigned The Shadow Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Shadow Board
options.lineage: Studio IX's warm-industrial room and the painted shadow board on a workshop pegboard
options.thesis: The site is the shop wall: every section hangs on a peg, and a painted outline marks where each thing belongs, including you.
options.viewport: A full-bleed green pegboard with the name on label-maker tape. The next-meetup date hangs as a hi-vis tag big enough to cross a panel seam, with Meetup and Slack hung as tools beside it.
options.risk: Tips into a garage-craft costume if the rendering gets literal. It has to stay flat, crisp and modern, and the hole grid must be the real layout grid.

raised.raise: Scale courage: the date tag is set big enough to break across a panel seam, one object crossing the board's joints.
Declared priority: every hung item has a phone rank, so a narrow screen collapses to date, then join, then the rest, never an accidental stack.
Live surface, not a texture: the perforation lattice is generated at runtime and is the layout grid at every width, so each item truly hangs on a hole.
One module as the ruler: About, Activities and Get Involved hang as identical tags at one hook spacing, read by sweeping the row.
One pull, one transformation: Learn More lifts the Studio IX tool off its hook, uncovering its painted outline and the tour details behind it.
Charged emptiness: an empty outline waits for the visitor in Join Us, and a TBA date leaves the tag's outline on the board, deliberate, not broken.

options.label: The Wall Calendar
options.lineage: The wall calendar everyone checks before committing to a Tuesday night
options.thesis: The next meetup is the product, so the homepage is this month's page with one day circled in marker.
options.viewport: This month's grid fills the screen with the meetup day circled in marker and linked to Meetup. In the TBA state the page tears to next month with a marker question mark.
options.risk: The most familiar of my candidates: 'the date is the hero' is where event sites land (the team guide even uses it as a lookbook example), and a grid can read like a scheduling app.

options.label: Itasha Vinyl Wrap
options.lineage: printed-vinyl wrapped cars with sponsor strips along the sill
options.thesis: The site as a wrapped car: name broken across panels, Studio IX as the sill sponsor strip.
options.viewport: The name wrapped across door panels, a number roundel, sponsor strip along the bottom.
options.case: Fuses poorly: neither audience lives in car-wrap culture, and the illustration it needs does not exist.
options.kept: Scale courage: one element breaking across seams.
options.risk: Costume without an illustration program behind it.

options.label: Dark Developer Console
options.lineage: graphite IDE panels with syntax-colored state
options.thesis: The group as a working console: panels for next meetup, join, sponsor.
options.viewport: Tiled panels with the next meetup in the primary pane.
options.case: Builders feel at home; newcomers read it as not for them, and near-black plus syntax accents is an AI-default look.
options.risk: Insider signal that beginners bounce off.

options.label: WebGL Shader Portal
options.lineage: experiential-studio portals over living shader fields
options.thesis: A breathing shader field with thin type floating over it.
options.viewport: One oversized word over a full-screen shader, tiny corner links.
options.case: The AI-startup gloss the brief rules out, and it hides the date behind a mood.
options.kept: A live-rendered surface, not a static texture.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.thesis: A row of needles, one per activity, leaning together.
options.viewport: A bridge of identical meters across the top, the date on the master meter.
options.case: There is no real signal to meter here, so the needles would be decoration.
options.kept: Identical repeated modules as the ruler.
options.risk: Instrument cosplay with nothing to measure.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.lineage: transforming fashion garments with drawcord channels
options.thesis: One gold cord pulls a flat plane into a shaped volume.
options.viewport: A black semicircle; pulling the cord gathers it into the page.
options.case: A luxury-fashion register that neither builders nor newcomers see themselves in.
options.risk: Precious where the group is practical.

options.label: Ikebana Ma
options.thesis: One branch, three stems, and charged emptiness.
options.viewport: An off-center arrangement with the name as a vertical line in quiet space.
options.case: Beautiful restraint, but too quiet for a room of people building things.
options.risk: Serene to the point of absent.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean, modern community landing page, played straight at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Left-aligned name and tagline, a next-meetup card with a Join button, then single-column sections and a sponsor block.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other meetup site by design.
